Asset type: illustrated game-design milestone storyboard for a research repository.
Primary request: Create ONE polished LANDSCAPE editorial storyboard sheet, aspect ratio 3:2, at high resolution, with EXACTLY SIX equal panels in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid. Each panel must illustrate the named milestone, not merely display an icon. Order left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Preserve all six milestone IDs exactly once. Use a consistent original small explorer in a muted teal cloak, stone ruins, painterly open-world fantasy landscapes, warm ivory paper background, crisp dark ink typography, restrained teal/ochre accents. Inspired by Breath of the Wild exploration but no franchise logos or named franchise characters.
Composition: generous top title band, six bordered rectangular panels with ample gutters, short footer. Every panel has a dark clearly readable ID and title at the top, a large central diagrammatic scene showing the required action with a few clean directional arrows and relevant objects, and three short readable caption lines at the bottom: DO, DONE, and the memory/skill tag. Keep all captions inside their own panel and distinct from the scene. Typography is large, clear sans-serif; no cursive. Use green success cues, amber learning, blue memory, purple transfer/composition, and red only for a specific unsafe state. Do not rely on color alone: retain text and symbols.
Critical: exact specified captions, no extra microtext, no invented milestone, no cropped panels, no duplicate numbers, no hallucinated UI paragraphs. Do not make the sheet look like actual in-engine screenshots. Draw useful spatial/mechanistic relationships so a reader can understand what the agent must do. A memory inset may show previously learned information but must not dominate the scene.

sheets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: illustrated game-design milestone storyboard for a research repository.
Primary request: Create ONE polished LANDSCAPE editorial storyboard sheet, aspect ratio 3:2, at high resolution, with EXACTLY SIX equal panels in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid. Each panel must illustrate the named milestone, not merely display an icon. Order left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Preserve all six milestone IDs exactly once. Use a consistent original small explorer in a muted teal cloak, stone ruins, painterly open-world fantasy landscapes, warm ivory paper background, crisp dark ink typography, restrained teal/ochre accents. Inspired by Breath of the Wild exploration but no franchise logos or named franchise characters.
Composition: generous top title band, six bordered rectangular panels with ample gutters, short footer. Every panel has a dark clearly readable ID and title at the top, a large central diagrammatic scene showing the required action with a few clean directional arrows and relevant objects, and three short readable caption lines at the bottom: DO, DONE, and the memory/skill tag. Keep all captions inside their own panel and distinct from the scene. Typography is large, clear sans-serif; no cursive. Use green success cues, amber learning, blue memory, purple transfer/composition, and red only for a specific unsafe state. Do not rely on color alone: retain text and symbols.
Critical: exact specified captions, no extra microtext, no invented milestone, no cropped panels, no duplicate numbers, no hallucinated UI paragraphs. Do not make the sheet look like actual in-engine screenshots. Draw useful spatial/mechanistic relationships so a reader can understand what the agent must do. A memory inset may show previously learned information but must not dominate the scene.
